items.title: Medical Physics in Cancer treatment (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Medical Physics in Cancer treatment: a main subheading of 20.5 Positron Emission Tomography, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 165-168.

blocks.text: Medical physics cancer ki diagnosis aur treatment mein bhi bohat important hai, khaas taur par radiotherapy mein. Radiotherapy high energy radiation se tumour ke cells ko maarti hai aur healthy (sehatmand) tissues ko kam se kam nuqsan deti hai. (Kitab 'high energy particles' likhti hai; zyada tar yeh high energy X-rays ya gamma rays hoti hain.) Radiation therapy ke do main (bare) tareeqe hain: teletherapy, jis mein radiation body ke bahar rakhi machine se di jati hai, aur brachytherapy, jis mein radioactive source tumour ke andar ya bilkul qareeb rakha jata hai.

Medical physicists bhi oncology (cancer ke ilaj ki) team ka hissa hain. Yeh equipment (machinon) ki quality assurance (theek kaam karne ki jaanch), treatment ke time ka calculation (hisaab), treatment planning aur cancer wale hisse mein dose distribution (dose kahan kitni) ka map banane ke specialist (mahir) hote hain. Yeh radiation oncologists, dosimetrists (dose naapne wale mahir) aur laboratory technicians ke saath mil kar har treatment ko safe aur clinically effective (mareez ke liye kaamyab) banate hain.

blocks.prompt: PET scanning mein coincidence detection ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf woh gamma rays ke pairs gine jate hain jo ek hi lamhe opposite detectors par pohanchein. Is liye har event (annihilation) un do detectors ko jorne wali seedhi line par hota hai. Bohat si aisi lines se annihilation ki location milti hai, aur akele (unrelated, be-talluq) photons reject (rad) ho jate hain.

items: SPECT: gamma rays chhorne wala tracer aur ghoomta hua gamma camera.
PET: tracer ka positron electron se annihilate hota hai; do gamma photons opposite directions mein, coincidence mein detect hote hain.
PET function (kaam) dikhata hai: cancer, brain, dil.
Radiotherapy: teletherapy (bahar se) aur brachytherapy (source andar ya qareeb).
